lines.text: An interface the controller uses to receive a presentation context.
Indicates to the presentment controller the presentation anchor that the controller's UI should be presented within.
Returning `nil` from this method will result in an ``IdentityDocumentPresentmentError/invalidRequest``
error being thrown when performing an authorization request.`
- Parameter presentmentController: The active presentment controller.
- Returns: The presentation anchor to use for presenting UI.
A closed protocol that indicates this object is a controller used for identity document presentment.
A controller that performs identity document requests originating from the web.
A delegate that provides information for the controller to perform a web presentment.
A delegate that provides a display context in which the system can present an authorization interface to the user.
Initialize a web presentment controller.
Perform an identity document request.

On iOS, this document will be sourced from a document provider installed on the current device. On other platforms, this will trigger a remote presentment flow where the user is prompted to use a nearby device for the presentment.
- Parameters:
- requests: A list of incoming document requests.
- origin: The origin of the requesting website.
- Returns: A response that contains the requested document information.
Defines a delegate used in conjunction with a web presentment controller.
A method that allows the calling app to provide the incoming raw web presentment requests to the web presentment controller.
If this method is unimplemented, then an ``IdentityDocumentPresentmentError/invalidRequest`` will be thrown from the web presentment controller.
- Parameter webPresentmentController: The active presentment controller.
- Returns: A list of raw web presentment requests.
The origin of the requesting website, if present.
The incoming ISO 18013 mobile document request.
Build and send an ISO 18013 mobile document response.
- Parameter responseHandler: A handler for building the response. This handler provides the raw web presentment request, and returns the ISO 18013 mobile document response.
Cancel the current request from the relying party.
Initialize an ISO 18013 mobile document raw request scene.
- Parameter content: A closure that builds the authorization UI with the provided context.
The content and behavior of the scene’s interface.
For the body of your scene, specify a ``PrimitiveAppExtensionScene`` structure
with the contents you want to display. You can also use that structure to configure
an XPC connection for handling any interface-related data exchanges.
The type for this scene’s body.
An app extension that provides an identity document.
Your extension will indicate which request types it supports through the provided `IdentityDocumentRequestScene` concrete types.
Based on which request types are used by the requesting party, the UI provided through your app extension will be presented to the user when they select your app to respond to a presentment request.
A body containing an identity document scene for each request type the app supports.
A function that allows the current app to perform updates to their document registrations to ensure they are consistent with the documents stored in the app.
The system will call this function periodically, including when the user enables the current app for document providing.
The configuration object for this app extension.
For any app extension that you create, provide a computed `configuration` property that
defines your app extension's configuration.
Swift infers the app extension's associated type based on the configuration
provided by the `configuration` property.
A scene that indicates support for a particular document request type.
Concrete types for this protocol are provided by the framework.
A result builder that combines one or more `IdentityDocumentRequestScene`s into a single scene.
